questions.question: What is the critical purpose of placing '<!DOCTYPE html>' on the very first line of an HTML document?
options: It informs the browser engine to render the page in standard HTML5 mode rather than legacy quirks mode
It assigns an administrative password to the web directory
It loads the default browser stylesheet
It registers the DNS server hostname
questions.explanation: The '<!DOCTYPE html>' directive signals modern HTML5 document parsing to avoid legacy quirks mode rendering.

questions.question: What primary architectural difference distinguishes the <head> element from the <body> element in HTML?
options: The <head> contains page metadata and settings; the <body> contains all visual document content
The <head> is rendered on mobile only; the <body> renders on desktop
The <head> contains graphical media; the <body> contains typography
There is no distinction; they are interchangeable
questions.explanation: The <head> element hosts invisible metadata, character sets, and assets; <body> encloses visible layout elements.

questions.question: Which principle represents semantic best practice regarding heading hierarchy (<h1> through <h6>)?
options: Use exactly one <h1> per page to define the primary subject for users and search engine crawlers
The <h6> tag displays the largest typography
Heading tags carry no semantic significance and serve purely as visual styling shortcuts
questions.explanation: An HTML document must maintain a logical outline; exactly one <h1> designates the primary topic of the page.

questions.question: Which attribute on an anchor tag (<a>) opens the destination URL in a new browser tab?
questions.explanation: Setting target='_blank' instructs the browser to open the linked resource in a new browsing context.

questions.question: What is the primary role of the 'alt' attribute on the element?
options: It provides alternative text for accessibility screen readers and fallback text if image loading fails
It sets the image border radius dynamically
It defines the high-DPI retina multiplier
It forces automatic image caching on proxy servers
questions.explanation: The 'alt' attribute provides descriptive alternative text indispensable for screen reader users and SEO indexers.

questions.question: Which Emmet abbreviation in VS Code expands into the complete HTML5 boilerplate structure?
questions.explanation: Typing '!' (exclamation mark) and pressing Tab or Enter in VS Code immediately generates the full HTML5 scaffold.

questions.question: What is the correct and valid syntax to link to the PhysicsWallah website?
questions.explanation: The anchor tag (<a>) pairing with 'href' constitutes standard HTML hyperlink syntax.

questions.question: How does the 'Live Server' extension in VS Code streamline web development workflow?
options: It hosts files on a local development server and triggers automatic browser reload on file save
It minifies JavaScript and CSS bundles into production builds
It converts HTML tags into React components automatically
It deploys static HTML directly to a public cloud CDN
questions.explanation: Live Server spawns a local development web server and injects live-reload web sockets upon file modifications.

questions.question: According to web standards and SEO guidelines, how many <h1> elements should appear per page?
questions.explanation: Best practices dictate a single <h1> heading per document representing the overarching topic.
